summary: Iteration-4 targeted verification of the 3 fixes from iteration_3 plus regression smoke. Backend: 104/104 pytest passed against the public preview URL (existing backend_test.py + test_new_features.py + new test_order_number_atomic.py). Atomic order numbers CONFIRMED FIXED: unique index on orders.order_number exists, 5 sequential creations are unique/monotonic/gapless, 10 concurrent POST /api/orders (10 threads) all succeeded with 10 distinct GAK-YYYYMMDD-#### numbers, and a full-collection aggregation found zero duplicate order_numbers. Frontend (Playwright, public URL): POS dine-in cart preservation CONFIRMED FIXED (added Ayam Tangkap Rp45.000, picked an empty table -> cart still 1 item / Rp45.000, table label shown as 'Meja: Meja 1'). Sync history reachability CONFIRMED FIXED (offline sale queued with offline receipt badge, auto-sync on 'online' emptied the queue, persistent 'Riwayat sinkron' button [open-history-btn] appeared and opened the dialog with sync-history showing OFF-1787193971859-22vhi -> GAK-20260820-0046 reconciliation; button correctly hidden when the log is empty). Regression smoke passed: admin + kasir login, take-away cash checkout (GAK-20260820-0045, change Rp141.000) with receipt print payload containing the order number, Orders page reprint buttons render, admin Dashboard loads all KPIs with zero console errors. One NEW minor defect found: duplicate sync-log entries due to a non-reentrant syncNow.

minor.issue: Still no brute-force throttling/lockout (pre-existing, playbook expects lockout after ~5 failures).
Pre-existing: kasir seed credentials hardcoded in server.py; CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' when CORS_ORIGINS unset (allow_credentials=False so not exploitable).

ui_bugs.issue: NEW (MEDIUM-LOW): syncNow has no re-entrancy guard, so two triggers (browser 'online' event + the effect's initial navigator.onLine call) run concurrently, both read the same pending list and both write a sync-log entry. Result: the same offline sale is logged twice ('1 transaksi disinkron' x2 for the identical client_ref OFF-...-22vhi -> GAK-20260820-0046). No duplicate order is created (backend dedupes on client_ref) but the history/reconciliation view over-reports, and the read-modify-write on gak_sync_log can also lose entries. Fix: guard with a syncing/in-flight ref and/or dedupe log entries by client_ref.
Pre-existing LOW (unchanged): cacheAt is read from localStorage during render without state/subscription, so 'Data ter-cache' can show a stale timestamp.
A11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby.

issues: 4 of 9 seeded products (Es Timun Serut, Roti Cane Kari, Teh Tarik, Kopi Espresso partially) render only the grey placeholder icon instead of a photo - seed image_url missing/broken for those items.

action_items: MEDIUM-LOW: add a re-entrancy guard to OfflineContext.syncNow (and/or dedupe sync-log items by client_ref) to stop duplicate sync-history entries.
LOW: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to POS + sync dialogs to clear the Radix a11y warning.
LOW (pre-existing, optional): login attempt throttling, kasir seed creds via env, explicit CORS_ORIGINS.
LOW: fix/replace missing seed product images.
critical_code_review_comments: gen_order_number(): atomic findOneAndUpdate($inc) + ReturnDocument.AFTER on db.counters plus the unique index on orders.order_number is the correct fix; the migration-safe seeding of the counter from count_documents runs only once per WIB day and is race-tolerant because it uses $setOnInsert with upsert.
Note: the counter never decreases, so hard-deleting orders (e.g. test cleanup) leaves gaps - acceptable and safer than the old count-based scheme.
POS.selectTable(): else-branch now only clears currentOrderId, preserving the cart; open-bill branch still replaces cart from the server order - both verified in the UI.
Layout.OfflineStatus: open-history-btn condition (pendingCount===0 && syncLog.length>0) is correct and reuses SyncQueueDialog, so no duplicate dialog code.

Only open defect left is the duplicate sync-log entry (OfflineContext.syncNow re-entrancy).
rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate sync-history entries: OfflineContext's effect calls syncNow() both on mount (navigator.onLine) and from the 'online' listener; syncNow only bails on an empty queue and has no in-flight lock, so two overlapping runs each POST the same queued order (backend returns the same order via client_ref idempotency) and each unshifts its own entry into gak_sync_log after a separate read, producing duplicate (and potentially lost) log rows.
